description: SCA-7317: JS reachability enrichment must succeed when package.json devEngines.runtime does not match the scanner's Node version (onFail=error). Before the fix every `npm view` exited 1 with EBADDEVENGINES and enrichment aborted.

logs._comment_expected_log_lines: EBADDEVENGINES must appear (the Unified Agent's own `npm config get package-lock` still hits it, out of scope for SCA-7317), proving the devEngines mismatch is live in the same scan. Reachability enrichment must not fail or abort.
